description: Swedish functional drink brand designed in Stockholm. Its product Daylight is a cacao-based drink mix with 11 dosed actives — dual-extracted lion's mane, cordyceps and chaga mushrooms, nicotinamide riboside (an NAD+ precursor), CDP-choline, L-theanine, rhodiola, MCT, 3 g collagen peptides and bee propolis — with no added caffeine, sold by subscription and one-time purchase, shipping across Sweden and the EU.

evidence.summary: Thunder Honey's own affiliate page states affiliates earn on each order placed with their code with 'No caps', and its FAQ answers 'How much can I earn?' with 'There is no cap' — verified uncapped. The page routes applications through Shopify Collabs and, while that setup is finished, invites applications to hello@thunderhoney.co; no percentage rate is published (rate is confirmed at approval), and affiliates also earn on recurring subscription orders.

Official homepage: 'Functional cacao. Developed in Sweden', designed in Stockholm, ships from Sweden with prices in SEK; 11 actives at named doses in a 12 g scoop, third-party tested by Eurofins, 2 years and 28 formulations in development, 70,000+ servings poured, 30-day money-back guarantee, and 1% of every order to bee conservation. Founders named as Joakim Bjarke and Nina Strauss.

name: Thunder Honey

reasons.compensation: Verified uncapped earnings on the brand's own page, including recurring subscription orders; the percentage itself is only confirmed at approval, which keeps this below the top band.
reasons.contact_access: Public affiliate page plus two published emails (hello@ for applications, support@ for general contact).
reasons.credibility: Young Swedish brand with third-party Eurofins testing, transparent full-dose labelling and 70,000+ servings sold, but limited track record.
reasons.niche_fit: Functional morning-drink ritual with strong before/after coffee-swap storytelling — a proven wellness UGC format.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application route via Shopify Collabs, with an email application route published while the Collabs setup is finished.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand runs a public affiliate program and features customer video/review content on its homepage, but publishes no structured creator program details beyond the affiliate page.

description: US women's wellness brand founded in 2019 by Jess Toolson and Cody Sanders, selling hormone-support drink-mix supplements in single-serve sticks (12 products), with 17K+ five-star reviews, 7M+ sticks sold and a community of 169K women.

evidence.summary: Mixhers' own affiliate page FAQ states: 'You earn a cash commission on every order placed through your link, with no cap' — verified uncapped. The program is powered by Social Snowball (apply at mixhers.socialsnowball.io), is free to join with no follower minimum, pays cash (not store credit) monthly, and publishes no percentage on the page itself.
FlexOffers' Mixhers program listing states affiliates earn 10% commissions on every sale with monthly payouts (listing published Jan 2025, updated Sep 2026).
Brand figures published on Mixhers' own affiliate page: 17K+ five-star reviews, 7M+ sticks sold, 300 MDs & OB/GYNs surveyed, 169K women in its community.

name: Mixhers

reasons.compensation: Verified uncapped cash commission; the 10% rate comes from the FlexOffers listing rather than the brand's own page, which publishes no percentage.
reasons.contact_access: Public affiliate page with a direct Social Snowball application link; no published partnerships email.
reasons.credibility: Established 2019 brand with 17K+ five-star reviews and 7M+ sticks sold.
reasons.niche_fit: Women's hormone-health drink mixes built for TikTok/Instagram creator content — squarely in the wellness UGC niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free to join with no follower minimum, per the brand's own page.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Large stated community (169K women) and a creator-facing affiliate program with cash payouts promoted on the brand's own page.

description: US family-run tea company started in rural Oregon in 2004, selling certified-organic Japanese whole-leaf green teas stone-milled into fine powders — matcha, sencha, hojicha, genmaicha and decaf versions — sourced from organic farms in Japan, so drinkers consume the whole leaf rather than an infusion.

evidence.summary: Yu Tea's own affiliate portal FAQ answers 'Is there a limit to how much I can earn?' with 'Not at all! The more you share, the more you earn. There's no cap on commissions' — verified uncapped. Terms on the portal: 60-day cookie, payouts at the start of the month once the balance exceeds $25, via PayPal, bank transfer or store credit; the page describes the rate only as 'attractive commissions', so no percentage is recorded.

Official homepage: Yu Tea started as a small family venture in rural Oregon in 2004; teas are stone-milled whole-leaf powders from certified organic farms in Japan; the footer publishes hello@yutea.com and the brand's Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and X URLs.

name: Yu Tea

reasons.compensation: Verified uncapped earnings with a 60-day cookie and cash payout options; no percentage is published, which caps this below the top band.
reasons.contact_access: Public affiliate portal plus a published general email and four social profiles on the official homepage.
reasons.credibility: Family business operating since 2004 with certified-organic sourcing and published batch testing for caffeine/catechin content.
reasons.niche_fit: Matcha and whole-leaf green tea powders ride a strong creator trend (matcha routines, taste tests), though the brand itself is quiet and traditional.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Self-serve affiliate portal open to applicants.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An open affiliate portal exists, but there is little public evidence of structured creator campaigns beyond it.

description: US meal-planning subscription service built around weekly meal plans made from 20 fresh ingredients, sold through the All Access Pass, Annual Meal Plans, the Mind Body Reset Library and the Healthy Living Bundle.

evidence.summary: The Fresh 20's own partner page states: 'For each sale of a paid subscription, you'll receive a 15% commission, paid out monthly with no cap on your earning potential!' and repeats 'No cap on commissions!' — verified uncapped at a 15% rate. The program is open to everyone with no following required.

The same page carries 'Earn up to 20%' headlines and one visibly unfinished section containing '(CONFIRM)' draft markers (that draft section mentions monthly PayPal payouts over $50 and an exclusive 10% audience discount). The 15% figure is the one stated as the operative term three times; the draft fragments should be confirmed with the brand.

name: The Fresh 20

reasons.compensation: 15% commission with verified uncapped earning potential stated on the brand's own page; payout mechanics are partly in an unfinished draft section.
reasons.contact_access: Public partner signup page; no published partnerships email found.
reasons.credibility: Long-running meal-planning service, but its partner page still contains unfinished draft copy, which dents polish.
reasons.niche_fit: Meal planning and weeknight-cooking content is a steady food-creator niche; a subscription service is less visual than a physical product.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to everyone, no following required, per the brand's own page.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A public partner program exists, but there is little visible creator-content evidence around the brand.

description: US food brand founded in 2011 by clinical nutritionist Sharon Brown and based in Carlsbad, California, selling organic frozen bone broth and soups direct-to-consumer and through grocery retail.

evidence.summary: Bonafide Provisions' own affiliate registration page (run on UpPromote) sets the commission type as 'Flat Rate Per Order' at $10: 'You will earn $10 every time a customer makes a purchase through your affiliate link or uses your coupon code. The customer will also receive 15% off their order.' No earnings-cap statement is published, so the cap is recorded as unknown.
Company profiles describe Bonafide Provisions as founded in 2011 by Sharon Brown, a clinical nutritionist, headquartered in Carlsbad, California, selling organic frozen bone broth and soups.

name: Bonafide Provisions

reasons.compensation: Flat $10 per order regardless of basket size, plus a 15% customer discount to drive conversion — simple and published, but modest on small orders.
reasons.contact_access: Public registration page on the brand's own affiliate portal; no published partnerships email.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2011, founder is a clinical nutritionist, and the products are sold through national grocery retail as well as DTC.
reasons.niche_fit: Bone broth sits in the gut-health/wellness-food crossover that food and wellness creators actively post about.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A public affiliate registration with a customer discount code exists; limited public evidence of larger creator campaigns.

description: US tea merchant based in New York selling premium unblended Chinese teas — aged Liu Bao, oolong (wulong), Liu An, Tibetan tea and aged loose pu-erh, including vintage collector teas — with no additives or preservatives.

evidence.summary: Generation Tea's merchant-authored Awin profile states: 'Generation Tea pays you 20% on products purchased by your visitors. For example, a typical sale to new customers is around $50, meaning that you would earn $10 on a typical sale.' No earnings-cap statement is published, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

RateTea's brand profile describes Generation Tea as a tea company based in Monsey, NY, founded by Michael Sanft and co-owned by Marci Sanft, specialising in artisanal Chinese teas, especially aged teas; the brand's own pages show a Spring Valley, NY address.
Official homepage sells unblended Chinese teas including aged Liu Bao, oolong, Liu An, Tibetan tea and aged loose pu-erh (Beeng Cha, Tuo Cha and Zun Cha cakes).

name: Generation Tea

reasons.compensation: 20% commission stated on the merchant's own Awin profile with a ~$50 typical order; no cap statement published.
reasons.contact_access: Joining runs through the Awin merchant profile; no published partnerships email found.
reasons.credibility: Long-running specialist tea merchant with a physical New York presence and deep collector catalogue.
reasons.niche_fit: Premium and vintage Chinese tea is a small but passionate creator niche (tea ceremony, tastings, aged-tea collecting).
reasons.ugc_evidence: A live network affiliate program exists, but public creator-content evidence around the brand is thin.

description: Canadian premium tea retailer (styled Cup of Té) based in Ontario, founded by Taylor Lindsay-Noel, selling organic loose-leaf teas and teaware; the brand was featured on Oprah's Favorite Things and gives a portion of proceeds to mental-health awareness causes.

evidence.summary: Lasso's affiliate directory lists the Cup of Te program at 15% per sale and links joining through the brand's GoAffPro portal (cupofte.goaffpro.com). No earnings-cap statement is published, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Official homepage states twice that Cup of Té is 'a premier online retailer of loose leaf organic teas and teaware. Based in Ontario, Canada', names founder Taylor Lindsay-Noel, and carries the Oprah's Favorite Things feature; the store shows 286 customer reviews.

name: Cup of Te

reasons.compensation: 15% per sale per the Lasso directory listing of the brand's GoAffPro program; no cap statement published.
reasons.contact_access: Public GoAffPro application portal; no published partnerships email found.
reasons.credibility: Oprah's Favorite Things feature and a strong founder story, with hundreds of store reviews.
reasons.niche_fit: Giftable organic loose-leaf tea and teaware with a compelling founder narrative — good lifestyle/food creator fit.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application via the brand's GoAffPro portal.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand works with creators through its affiliate portal and trades on story-led content, though no structured ambassador program is published.

description: US supplement company founded in 2022 by Dan and Sienna McCormick and based in New York, maker of the first creatine monohydrate gummies plus creatine + electrolytes drink mixes — vegan, gluten-free and non-GMO — sold direct-to-consumer and through major retailers including Target.

evidence.summary: Lasso's affiliate directory lists the Create Wellness program at up to 22.5% per sale (a rate ceiling, not an earnings cap) with a 14-day cookie, no approval requirements and a $10 payout threshold, routed through Amazon. No earnings-cap statement is published, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

CB Insights' company profile: Create Wellness was founded in 2022 and is headquartered at 250 Broadway, New York, NY, United States, specialising in creatine supplementation (gummies and an electrolytes-infused creatine mix).

name: Create Wellness

reasons.compensation: Up to 22.5% per sale per Lasso — a high ceiling — but it is Amazon-routed and the 'up to' basis is not broken down further.
reasons.contact_access: Joining runs through the Lasso listing; no published partnerships email or own program page found.
reasons.credibility: Venture-backed (Series B) 2022 brand with national retail distribution including Target.
reasons.niche_fit: Creatine gummies are a heavily creator-driven fitness/wellness product with strong short-form video demand.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Listed with no approval requirements on Lasso.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand markets heavily through fitness creators and ambassadors on social, though the joinable route documented here is the Lasso/Amazon program.

description: Austin, Texas beverage company founded in 2015 selling organic sparkling yerba mate with 160 mg of natural caffeine in low- and zero-calorie options; the company gives 50% of its profits to the CLEAN Cause Foundation, which supports people in recovery from alcohol and drug addiction.

evidence.summary: Lasso's affiliate directory lists the CLEAN Cause program at 30% per sale with a 60-day cookie, and its join button routes to ShareASale. No earnings-cap statement is published, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Smartrr's client showcase describes Clean Cause as an Austin-based beverage company producing organic sparkling yerba mate drinks, donating 50% of profits to the CLEAN Cause Foundation to support individuals in recovery from alcohol and drug addiction.

name: Clean Cause

reasons.compensation: 30% per sale with a 60-day cookie per Lasso — one of the strongest published rates in this batch; no cap statement published.
reasons.contact_access: Joining runs through the Lasso listing into ShareASale; no published partnerships email found.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2015 with a registered foundation mission and national DTC presence.
reasons.niche_fit: Sparkling yerba mate energy drinks plus a recovery-support mission give creators both a product and a story.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A live network affiliate program exists; public evidence of structured creator campaigns is limited.

description: US coffee subscription brand selling Rainforest Alliance Certified coffee in 100% compostable pods for Keurig and Nespresso machines, plus sustainably sourced ground coffee, roasted fresh weekly and packed in eco-friendly materials.

evidence.summary: Tayst Coffee's merchant-authored Awin profile lists a $15 commission per sale, average order value $47.56 and a 30-day cookie window, with a dedicated 'UGC Creators & Influencers' section (samples, first access to new blends, brand features, performance bonuses) and the contact partner@tayst.com. No earnings-cap statement is published, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

An older LinkClicky directory listing (March 2024) puts Tayst on ShareASale at $13 per sale, which conflicts with the current Awin profile's $15 per sale on both network and amount; per house rules the commission rate is therefore recorded as null until the brand confirms which program is live.

name: Tayst Coffee

reasons.compensation: A flat per-sale bounty is advertised ($15 on the current Awin profile), but an older directory conflicts ($13 on ShareASale), so no rate is recorded and compensation scores conservatively.
reasons.contact_access: Published partnerships email (partner@tayst.com) on the Awin profile plus a public program page.
reasons.credibility: Established subscription coffee brand built around the world's first compostable pod, with Rainforest Alliance Certified beans.
reasons.niche_fit: Coffee subscriptions and sustainability swaps are reliable food/drink creator content angles.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Awin, with an explicit creator/influencer track.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The Awin profile has a dedicated UGC creators and influencers section offering samples, early access and collaborative campaigns.
